about: The `table_semantics` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain.

rows.grain: one row per MUNIS account
rows.what_it_answers: The town's chart of accounts — every account number with its fund

rows.grain: one row per abbreviated account name
rows.what_it_answers: What a ten-character MUNIS name actually expands to.
rows.caution: The expansions are ours except where `basis` says otherwise.

rows.grain: one row per table per annual report
rows.what_it_answers: Every table found by reading all sixteen annual reports end to end.
rows.caution: A catalogue of what EXISTS, not of what has been extracted.

rows.grain: one row per extracted table
rows.what_it_answers: Which tables were read

rows.grain: one row per revenue line per year
rows.what_it_answers: Every receipt the annual reports print

rows.grain: one row per page surveyed
rows.what_it_answers: What each page of each report looks like to an extractor.
rows.caution: A survey, not data: it measures pages, it does not read figures.

rows.grain: one row per fee per year
rows.what_it_answers: What the district charged families to play

rows.grain: one row per sport per season per metric
rows.what_it_answers: Participation and cost by sport.

rows.grain: one row per printed total
rows.what_it_answers: Whether the by-sport rows sum to the totals the source prints.

rows.grain: one row per athletics figure per year
rows.what_it_answers: Both sides of athletics — what the town appropriated and what the fund spent.
rows.caution: Appropriation, fund revenue and fund spending are three quantities. Never add two of them.

rows.grain: one row per ballot question
rows.what_it_answers: What each override and debt exclusion asked and how the town voted.

rows.grain: one row per line per year per stage per variant
rows.what_it_answers: What a budget document said a line would be — or was.
rows.caution: Split on `stage` AND `variant`. FY27 carries four whole budgets.
rows.default_query: SELECT f.fy, f.stage, f.variant, f.label, f.value, b.section, b.function_group, f.doc_id FROM budget_figure f LEFT JOIN budget_line b USING (line_key) ORDER BY f.fy, f.stage, f.value DESC LIMIT 1000

rows.grain: one row per budget line
rows.what_it_answers: The district's line list
rows.caution: with its section and function group.

rows.grain: one row per year
rows.what_it_answers: Where capital spending was funded from.

rows.grain: one row per project
rows.what_it_answers: The FY27 capital plan as proposed

rows.grain: one row per budget line mapped to an account
rows.what_it_answers: Intended to join a budget line to a ledger account. It is EMPTY.
rows.caution: Deliberately empty. MUNIS truncates to ten characters so MS GUIDANC and HS GUIDANC collide; only the CATEGORY can be joined, through account.function. Populating this would record an inference as a mapping.

rows.grain: one row per dataset per document
rows.what_it_answers: Which document every extracted dataset row came from.

rows.grain: one row per district per year per measure
rows.what_it_answers: DESE's own published measures for every district.

rows.grain: one row per district per year per measure
rows.what_it_answers: DESE's all-funds per-pupil figures.
rows.caution: All-funds, so NOT comparable with the town's general fund appropriation.

rows.grain: one row per source document
rows.what_it_answers: Every document in the archive with its address and checksum.
rows.caution: `link_state` says whether the publisher's copy still opens; `copy_state` whether it still matches ours.

rows.grain: one row per planned extract
rows.what_it_answers: What was planned to be read out of the annual reports
rows.caution: and what state each is in.

rows.grain: one row per MUNIS period
rows.what_it_answers: What each accounting period means and how much of the year had elapsed.
rows.caution: Period 13 is the year-end close after the lapse period, not a thirteenth month.

rows.grain: one row per line of the state's proof
rows.what_it_answers: How the state computed certified free cash

rows.grain: one row per MUNIS fund
rows.what_it_answers: Every fund the town runs

rows.grain: one row per transaction
rows.what_it_answers: The athletics revolving fund at transaction level

rows.grain: one row per fund per year per period
rows.what_it_answers: What each fund took in
rows.default_query: SELECT a.fy, a.period, a.fund, f.name, f.kind, f.restriction, a.revenue, a.salaries, a.expenditure, a.encumbered, a.closing_balance FROM fund_activity a LEFT JOIN fund f USING (fund) ORDER BY a.closing_balance DESC LIMIT 1000

rows.grain: one row per grant per year
rows.what_it_answers: Grants awarded

rows.grain: one row per grant per year
rows.what_it_answers: The same grants with their source addresses.

rows.grain: one row per account per year per period per document
rows.what_it_answers: What the town's books say
rows.caution: at a moment in the year.
rows.default_query: SELECT l.fy, l.period, l.account_id, a.name, a.fund_name, a.dept, a.function, a.account_type, a.level, l.original, l.revised, l.expended, l.encumbered, l.available FROM ledger_snapshot l JOIN account a USING (account_id) ORDER BY l.fy, l.period, l.account_id LIMIT 1000

rows.grain: one row per line per year per stage
rows.what_it_answers: Every budget line

rows.grain: one row per source document
rows.what_it_answers: How much of each budget document was successfully read.

rows.grain: one row per disagreeing reading
rows.what_it_answers: Where two documents state different figures for the same line-year.
rows.caution: Kept rather than resolved. Which document is right is often not established.

rows.grain: one row per budget book line
rows.what_it_answers: The district's own budget book
rows.caution: in its own shape and column order.

rows.grain: one row per assumption
rows.what_it_answers: Every assumption the money model rests on

rows.grain: one row per revenue account or fund or department
rows.what_it_answers: Our classification of every money node — what it is and how that was established.
rows.caution: `how` and `why` carry the basis so a classification can be argued with.

rows.grain: one row per traced edge
rows.what_it_answers: Where a restricted fund's money is permitted to go.
rows.caution: An edge is the statute or grant award — a PRESUMPTION about purpose, never an observation of spending.

rows.grain: one row per gap
rows.what_it_answers: Questions the published documents do not close.
rows.caution: This table is the honest list of what cannot be answered.

rows.grain: one row per account per report
rows.what_it_answers: The MUNIS chart of accounts exactly as delivered.

rows.grain: one row per year per stage
rows.what_it_answers: Out-of-district tuition

rows.grain: one row per year
rows.what_it_answers: Children placed outside the district

rows.grain: one row per rate
rows.what_it_answers: Every rate and fee the model uses

rows.grain: one row per anomaly
rows.what_it_answers: Things found while reading the annual reports that need a human.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Appropriations as the annual reports print them.
rows.caution: v1..v8 are ORDINALS. Read `column_meaning` and split on `status`.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Capital projects as the annual reports print them.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Debt as the annual reports print it.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Departmental activity tables from the annual reports.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Election results as the annual reports print them.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Enrollment and MCAS tables from the annual reports.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Gross wages as the annual reports print them.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Monty Tech figures from the annual reports.
rows.caution: Monty Tech is a DIFFERENT DISTRICT. Never add it to Lunenburg's schools.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Town officials as the annual reports list them.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Trust funds as the annual reports print them.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Valuation tables from the annual reports.

rows.grain: one row per printed line
rows.what_it_answers: Vital records counts from the annual reports.

rows.grain: one row per revenue source per year
rows.what_it_answers: Every source of town revenue by year
rows.caution: with our classification of what KIND it is.

rows.grain: one row per printed roster title
rows.what_it_answers: What job each printed roster title actually is.

rows.grain: one row per school fund
rows.what_it_answers: The schools' own funds at FY26 period 9.

rows.grain: one row per fund per year
rows.what_it_answers: Every fund outside the general appropriation

rows.grain: one row per year per stage
rows.what_it_answers: Special education paraprofessionals by school.
rows.caution: A budget line, not a headcount.

rows.grain: one row per year per stage
rows.what_it_answers: Special education teachers by school.
rows.caution: A budget line, not a headcount.

rows.grain: one row per year per stage
rows.what_it_answers: Special education transportation.

rows.grain: one row per printed roster title
rows.what_it_answers: Printed titles mapped to positions.

rows.grain: one row per school per position per year
rows.what_it_answers: How many names the town printed under each position.
rows.caution: A count of NAMES, with no FTE and no funding source. It is not a staffing level.

rows.grain: one row per person per year
rows.what_it_answers: The per-school staff rosters

rows.grain: one row per figure the town stated
rows.what_it_answers: Figures the town or district asserted in their own words

rows.grain: one row per year per stage
rows.what_it_answers: Total expenses as each document states them.

rows.grain: one row per year per stage
rows.what_it_answers: Total salaries as each document states them.

rows.grain: one row per department
rows.what_it_answers: The FY26 period 9 town ledger

rows.grain: one row per function group
rows.what_it_answers: How far each group's spending ran from its budget

rows.grain: one row per worksheet row per year per column
rows.what_it_answers: The FY27 workbook unpivoted
rows.caution: every cell quotable by its row.
rows.default_query: SELECT w.fy, w.column_kind, w.row_kind, w.row, b.label, w.value FROM workbook_figure w LEFT JOIN budget_line b USING (line_key) ORDER BY w.fy, w.row LIMIT 1000

rows.grain: one row per table in this database
rows.what_it_answers: What each table is: its role, its grain, and what question it answers.
rows.caution: Self-describing, and checked both ways: a table with no row here fails the build, and a row naming a table that no longer exists fails it too.

rows.grain: one row per DISTINCT column name across the whole database
rows.what_it_answers: What a column name means, its unit, and what goes wrong if it is ignored.
rows.caution: Keyed on the NAME, not on table plus name, because `v1` and `status` mean the same dangerous thing everywhere they appear. Where a name genuinely differs by table, the table entry says so.
